The experimental menu and all 28 switches are shipped; nothing new from this run. The only part left is a picture of the sub-page and its critic score, which I can't do yet.

- **Shipped:** v32.99 to v33.06 covered the Settings row, the sub-page and every switch. Each ship passed the gate with the seed 4242 fingerprint holding at ents 85/374 and containers 165/593 with all switches on. I did not re-run those gates this time.
- **Dropped:** golden clue hunt, mimic crates and the lockdown alarm are gone from the game, so they got no switch. The 30 on the old flag map became 28 rows.
- **Blocked:** the camera has no screen for the experimental page. My question to add screen 79 is still open at `questions.md` line 47, so I haven't added it or asked again. Once he allows it, the steps are:
  1. Add screen 79 to `ui-screens-js.json`.
  2. Shoot it at 1080 and 4K.
  3. Run the critic against the finish line of 3.
- **Untested guards:** four small guards have no check of their own: the pad chord for air strike, the air strike word in `flowNetWord`, the overheat 1.5x line, and the stuck-rule lines in search. Each is a one-condition edit next to guarded code.
- **Not written:** there is no single all-switches-off fingerprint check. The affix check does prove seed 4242's body count is unchanged with affixes off. Barrels go in `G.brl`, so they don't touch the fingerprint either.
- **Watch next play:** with every switch on, the game should play exactly as before. Flip a few off in Settings, then experimental, and confirm the raid features actually go quiet.

NEXT: nothing further on this task until screen 79 is allowed.
